body.text: You have had {param:years} years of us, and we have had {param:years} years of you. I write to tell you that the arrangement is changing, and that you had no part in the decision.
His Majesty's obligations have grown. They did not grow because of anything you did or failed to do out there, which I say partly to spare your feelings and partly because it is true.
What it means for you is this: the figures will be larger. The same men will write to you about the same matters and ask for more than they asked last year, and they will ask again the year after.
A colony is a thing that is expected to grow. You will find that expectation is not a compliment.
Build something that produces, and quickly. I say that as a friend, which I am not.
I do not expect you to manage it. I have been wrong before, though not often, and not lately.

options.text: and thank you for the warning, such as it was
and note you took your time in sending it
and would ask what is left to give
and understand it exactly as it was meant

tone.hateful: The revised figures are enclosed. I recommend you sit down.
